proof_scope: Pure restricted bounded measures dominate indicator densities; the bounded mixed theorem passes through NPP locality. Both pure products annihilate the local pole union, forcing densities to vanish there. Convex inequality follows by multilinearity. For uniqueness, a null difference level with intermediate mass gives an auxiliary prescribed measure q^n 1_U mu. Class convexity and mixed inequality lower-bound its convex combinations. Full-mass comparison yields a scalar ratio tending to q>1; dominated strict-set indicators contradict positive U mass. Two-way domination upgrades common-measure equality to pointwise equality, including poles. n=1 explicit; no zero-reference-mass uniqueness assertion. Earlier broad verification gates preserved.
